paragraphs.text: The Araba (ah-RAH-bah; Japanese: 荒 場 ; literally: "Wasteland"; Kamigawan: lit. "ruined land" ) was a region within the Towabara Plains , on which Eiganjo Castle stood. It was devastated in the Kami War , and this devastation is reflected in the meaning of its name.
Reito was a decimated, abandoned human city on the Araba where the kami first attacked the people of the material world. Its name reflected this, meaning “ghost city” or “city of spirits.”
